# dsh-secret-guard
A fail-closed secret-like payload guard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) tool calls.
The plugin inspects model-supplied tool arguments at `tools/pre-execute` and returns `allow`, `ask`,
or `deny` before the tool body runs. v0.1 deliberately does **not** rewrite/redact arguments: DSH f
reezes execution identity and arguments before policy, so mutating them inside a guard would violate
the runtime contract.
